## Purpose

The homepage (`/`): it loads the module status text and renders `ModuleStatus` ([`features/status`](status.md)). It loads no CV data; the CV lives on `/cv`.

## Techniques

Server Component (web RULES "Page layout"); `app/page.tsx` renders only it.

## Technologies

React.

## Entry points

`PageHome` (rendered by `app/page.tsx`).

## Where to change what

The status text, card and check live in `features/status`; change what `/` shows here.
